accountInsightsAccountMismatch: The Google page belongs to a different account. Sign in to the selected account before refreshing.

accountInsightsBalanceUnavailable: Google has not exposed an exact readable prepaid balance here. This does not mean the balance is zero.
accountInsightsBillingAccountSelection: Google opened a different billing account. Select the matching billing account on the official page before refreshing.
accountInsightsBillingUnavailable: The official billing page could not be read. Check its billing account and sign-in state.
accountInsightsBrowserRequired: Reading these financial pages requires a valid browser login for this account. Add or renew the matching browser session. Official OAuth API requests do not need it.
accountInsightsCreditsSeparate: Prepaid balance and credits are shown separately. Values with unknown scope are not added together.
accountInsightsCreditsUnavailable: Google Cloud credit details could not be read. Open the official credit page to check them.
accountInsightsCreditsUnknown: Promotional credit details are not exposed here. Check Google Cloud Credits for remaining amounts, expiry dates and scope.
accountInsightsDescription: Read official billing and quota data for the selected account. Financial pages currently need its matching browser login.
accountInsightsEligibleGcpCreditsHint: This is the eligible credit figure shown by AI Studio. It can overlap with promotional credit details below and is not added to them.
accountInsightsHistoricalPeak: Usage values are the highest observed usage over the last 28 days, not current consumption. No remaining allowance is calculated from them.
accountInsightsIdentityUnconfirmed: This account’s identity has not been confirmed. Verify an OAuth account first, or save the Google browser login again, then refresh.
accountInsightsLoadFailed: Could not load account data. Use Refresh from Google to retry.
accountInsightsNeedsPrepaidCredit: A prepaid credit balance is required to resume service
accountInsightsNoAccounts: Import an OAuth JSON account or save a Google browser login to select an account.
accountInsightsOAuthFinanceHelp: Official OAuth API requests do not need a browser login. Reading Google’s financial pages currently requires a saved browser login for the same verified email; unavailable balance data does not block OAuth inference.
accountInsightsOAuthIdentityUnverified: Verify the OAuth identity first so the server can match it to the saved billing browser account. This verification is separate from choosing the API channel.
accountInsightsOfficialPageRedirected: The official page redirected unexpectedly. Check the Google sign-in and billing account before refreshing.
accountInsightsPrepaidLabel: Prepaid balance reported by AI Studio
accountInsightsPrepayDepleted: Google reports that prepaid credits are depleted
accountInsightsQuotaExplanation: These are official Gemini API limits. AI Studio browser requests may follow different limits. The project’s rotation counter is not a Google quota or remaining balance.
accountInsightsQuotaPageUnavailable: The official rate-limit page could not be read. Try refreshing again later.
accountInsightsQuotaTruncated: Only the models currently visible on Google’s page are included. Open the official rate-limit page to view more.
accountInsightsQuotaUnavailable: Google has not exposed readable quota values for this account. Open the official usage page to check them.
accountInsightsRefreshHint: This is a cached snapshot. Refresh manually for current data; unknown values are not zero.
accountInsightsSessionChanged: The account session changed during this query. Refresh to read the current account session.
accountInsightsSystemBusy: The service is processing an API request. Refresh account data after it finishes.
accountInsightsTimeout: Google took too long to respond. Refresh again later.

oauthAccountsDescription: Import refresh-token JSON for the official Gemini API channel, or keep using saved browser logins with Build.
oauthBrowserLoginRequired: The Build channel requires a saved browser login for this Google account. The official OAuth channel can use these credentials without a browser login.
oauthChannelActiveAccountDelete: This account is used by the default or fixed OAuth channel. Change its target before deleting the account.
oauthChannelBuildHelp: Build uses the existing Google browser sessions. The fixed official endpoint can independently use its configured OAuth account.
oauthChannelFixedEndpoints: Fixed channel endpoints (OAuth requires a configured account and project):
oauthChannelLazyVerification: This account’s identity has not been verified yet. You can verify now, or the server will validate the credentials when an API request is made.
oauthChannelLoadFailed: Could not load the current channel. Reload the page before changing it.
oauthChannelManagedByEnvironment: This channel is managed by server environment variables. Change the server configuration to update it.
oauthChannelOfficialHelp: Official OAuth requests are billed to the Cloud project entered here and follow its Gemini API quota, separately from Build. Saving only changes configuration; it does not send a model request.
oauthChannelSaveFailed: Could not save the channel. Check the OAuth account, Cloud project and server configuration.
oauthChannelUnsaved: Channel changes have not been saved.
oauthDeleteConfirm: Delete this saved OAuth credential? Its existing browser login will be retained.
oauthErrorBrowserJson: This is a browser session JSON. Import it through the existing browser auth file upload instead.
oauthErrorIdentityMismatch: This token does not match the declared or previously verified Google account. Check the account identity before importing again.
oauthErrorIdentityScope: This token cannot verify the Google identity. It needs permission to read the account’s verified email (OpenID/email scopes).
oauthErrorIdentityUnverified: Google did not return a verified email for this token. The identity has not been confirmed.
oauthErrorInvalidClient: The OAuth client is invalid or does not match this refresh token. Use the client that issued the token.
oauthErrorInvalidEmail: The JSON contains an invalid account email.
oauthErrorInvalidGrant: The refresh token could not be refreshed. It may be expired, revoked, or paired with a different OAuth client.
oauthErrorInvalidJson: Invalid JSON account format. Use an object, an array, or an accounts array.
oauthErrorInvalidProject: The JSON contains an invalid project ID.
oauthErrorTimeout: Google verification timed out. Try verifying again later.
oauthErrorTooManyAccounts: Import at most 1,000 accounts at a time.
oauthErrorUnsupportedType: This is not a supported Google OAuth account JSON. Use Google authorized-user or compatible OAuth credentials.
oauthImportHelp: Paste a Google OAuth JSON object, an array, or an object with an accounts array. Each account needs a refresh_token. Include its issuing client_id/client_secret, or configure the client on the server. Set the Cloud project in the JSON or channel settings.
oauthImportPrivacy: Credentials are sent only to this server. They are not saved in browser storage or shown in import results; the input is cleared after a successful import or closing this dialog.
oauthImportSaved: Saved. Select the official OAuth channel or add a browser login for Build.
oauthImportTooLarge: The total JSON size must not exceed 5 MiB.
oauthLoadFailed: Could not load OAuth accounts. Reload the page to retry.
oauthNeedsClient: The OAuth client ID that issued this refresh token is required, together with its client secret when the client requires one. Configure them on the server or include them in the JSON, then verify again.
oauthNoAccounts: No OAuth JSON accounts imported yet.
oauthOperationFailed: The operation failed. Check the OAuth configuration and try again.
onlyAppliesWhenStreamingEnabled: only applies when streaming is enabled
